name: listmonk
summary: A free tool to send email newsletters to your list. You run it yourself.
gains: No per-contact pricing: 500 or 500,000 subscribers costs the same
tradeoffs: You also need an email-sending service (e.g. Amazon SES, roughly $0.10 per 1,000 emails)
setupSteps: Rent a small server (shared with your other apps)
Connect an email-sending service via SMTP and set up SPF/DKIM on your domain
Send a test campaign to yourself first
commercialNote: AGPL: free to use, including for business. If you modify it and let other people use it over the internet, you must publish your changes under the same license.
